scope: 18 agents recovered from the current GPT Masterclass; expanded operating prompts
format_notice: Pack metadata. Not a native ADK configuration or installed runtime.
model: Choose an available model in the existing runtime; no model is configured by this pack.

agents.name: Sales
agents.description: Turns qualified inquiries into tailored offers, proposals and a verifiable next sales action.
agents.template_pattern: greeting_agent for a first single agent; customer_service for triage/research/response stages

agents.name: Production
agents.description: Converts confirmed HoneyPott bookings into executable culinary production and service plans.
agents.template_pattern: project_management for task breakdown/parallel resources-risks-timeline/synthesis; greeting_agent for the first version

agents.name: Client Experience
agents.description: Maintains client continuity, accurate booking status, communications and issue resolution.

agents.name: Finisher
agents.description: Selects one valuable near-complete asset and closes the remaining work to a defined finish.
agents.template_pattern: greeting_agent; project_management only for a genuinely complex finish

agents.name: Money
agents.description: Reconciles business cash, costs, obligations and margins into clear operating decisions.
agents.template_pattern: greeting_agent; financial_advisor is a stock-trading demo and must not be reused unchanged

agents.name: Opportunity
agents.description: Finds and qualifies real public-sector, corporate and commercial opportunities across Empire G capabilities.
agents.template_pattern: verified_recommendations for screening and validation; greeting_agent for the first version

agents.name: Research & Intelligence
agents.description: Answers a specific decision question with current evidence, comparisons and explicit uncertainty.
agents.template_pattern: brand_intelligence or competitive_analysis with real research tools

agents.name: Creative Director
agents.description: Turns a defined offer or story into a coherent, specific creative direction and production brief.
agents.template_pattern: greeting_agent; brand_intelligence only when research is needed

agents.name: Tech & Product
agents.description: Builds and repairs the smallest reliable product flow using existing repositories and tools.
agents.template_pattern: software_assistant after removing simulated search and connecting actual tools

agents.name: Publishing & IP
agents.description: Develops, packages and organizes original books, digital products and licensable IP.
agents.template_pattern: content_pipeline for drafting/editing/formatting; greeting_agent for the first version

agents.name: Content & Distribution
agents.description: Turns an approved offer or asset into channel-specific content and a measurable distribution plan.
agents.template_pattern: content_pipeline with actual research/publishing tools only when authorized

agents.name: Chief of Staff
agents.description: Coordinates the Empire G portfolio, priorities, agent handoffs and decision queue.
agents.template_pattern: greeting_agent for a coordinator; project_management as a workflow pattern after explicit state wiring

agents.name: Memory & Knowledge
agents.description: Maintains a sourced, versioned record of portfolio facts, decisions, assets and continuity.
agents.template_pattern: greeting_agent with a real file/database search and write capability

agents.name: Travel & Logistics
agents.description: Builds feasible travel, routing and movement plans around real commitments and constraints.
agents.template_pattern: project_management or greeting_agent with real maps/calendar/travel research tools

agents.name: Partnerships
agents.description: Qualifies partners and develops mutually useful, evidence-backed collaboration proposals.
agents.template_pattern: verified_recommendations or brand_intelligence with actual company/contact research

agents.name: Lacy Sounds Music & Artist
agents.description: Runs music/artist development, catalog integrity, release preparation and WLCY programming.
agents.template_pattern: content_pipeline for release preparation; project_management for release dependencies

agents.name: Soulfire Studios Film & TV
agents.description: Develops original screen concepts into coherent, pitchable and producible film/TV packages.
agents.template_pattern: content_pipeline for concept-to-package; project_management for production planning

agents.name: Character & Storyworld
agents.description: Creates and protects character identity, canon, continuity and storyworld expansion rules.
agents.template_pattern: greeting_agent with real canon retrieval/write tools; content_pipeline for bible creation

implementation_note: Three agent definitions added on empire-g-build; live API evaluation and account integrations are not configured.
